title: DFS Traversals
definition: Depth-First Search goes deep into a tree before going wide. The three variations are Pre-Order (Root, Left, Right), In-Order (Left, Root, Right), and Post-Order (Left, Right, Root).
simpleExplanation: Walking through a maze by always keeping your hand on the left wall until you hit a dead end, then backing up.

answers.question: **Basic:** Inorder Traversal (Recursive)
**Advanced:** Inorder Traversal (Iterative)
